data.title: 欧根亲王 · 假期阳台的落肩毛衣晨光
data.description: 海景公寓阳台被清晨温暖的初阳洒满，空气中带着淡淡的海风与咖啡醇香。欧根穿着极其宽大厚实的米白落肩毛衣，衣摆下露出白皙光洁的长腿。她双手抱着热气蒸腾的马克杯，赤足踩在温热木地板上。银白长发略带蓬松，她微笑着歪着头，眼角泪痣在晨光中透着居家的慵懒与极尽宠溺。
data.action: leaning against balcony door barefoot, oversized off-shoulder cream knit sweater slipping down, holding steaming mug with both hands, playful morning wink
data.location: sunlit seaside apartment wooden balcony with tropical plants
data.lighting: bright cheerful morning sunlight bathing white wool and bare skin
data.mood: effortlessly sultry domesticity, playful morning happiness
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot on a sunny seaside balcony, Prinz Eugen holds a warm mug wearing a slouchy off-shoulder knit sweater. Morning light catches her bare legs and red hair streak as she winks with relaxed, teasing affection.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen on a sunny balcony in an off-shoulder knit sweater holding coffee, winking.
